one_line: A top-down unboxing with a side view of the thick pages, then the real recipients opening it.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 top-down: a hand on a closed white box with a TinyBook sticker; 0:01 the lid opens to a card; the book is out of tissue by 0:03. Voice and subtitle (transcript): "תראו איזה ספר מיוחד הזמנתי מ TinyBook".
q1_hook.why: Voice and subtitle open together on an invitation to look, with unboxing motion within a second (H1, H6, T3). But frame one is a closed box with a logo sticker, so the book shows only at 0:03 (S1), and the first words name the brand before any buyer or benefit (H2).

beats.what: Top-down hand on a TinyBook box; the lid opens to a card; the book comes out of tissue
Cover with an aunt and two girls in costume; back cover note; "זה ספר ילדים בעיצוב אישי"
beats.why: The finished cover and the product idea

beats.what: Flipped spreads with the girls and a baby in a forest; "אני בחרתי להכין אותו לאחייניות שלי"
beats.why: The aunt's own reason, in first person

beats.what: Side view of thick board pages, then a sunset spread; "הספר עצמו מושקע ברמה אחרת"
Dissolve: four children read on a tile floor, then a man reads with two girls on a sofa
beats.why: The first real reaction, 20 s in

beats.what: The man and two girls lean in; "והכי מרגש לראות אותן פותחות את הספר"
beats.why: The emotional line over the reaction

beats.what: Last spread, then the back cover with the aunt's dedication; "איזה רגע קסום ב TinyBook"
beats.why: A personal close, but with no ask

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: None. No question, tip or ask to comment, share or save in the video or the two-line caption.
q2_flow.why: A page flips every 1 to 2 s, so the eye keeps moving (R3, F8). The children's reaction comes only at 0:20, the emotional payoff of an aunt's gift story (R4, K2). The thickness and quality shots repeat the same point for about 7 s (R1).

q3_cta.what: None. The video ends on the subtitle "איזה רגע קסום ב TinyBook" (0:32) over the back cover. The caption has no code, link, question or ask.
q3_cta.why: No ask anywhere, so an interested viewer has no code, link or next step (C6). That avoids bait and clashing asks (C1, C2), but it leaves the sale to chance.

q4_shown.what: The TinyBook box, the inner card and the book, 0:00-0:05; the illustrated cover with an aunt and two girls, flipped spreads, thick board pages, 0:06-0:20; four children, then a man with two girls, reading it, 0:20-0:30; the back-cover dedication. No price, no real photo.
q4_shown.why: The box is opened at 0:01 and the book lifted by 0:03 (S1). An aunt's first-person line and the real recipients' reaction vouch for it (S6). No real photo sits beside the illustrated cover, so likeness is unproven (S2). Several children's faces appear with a book that carries their names (S5).

q5_edit.what: 3 hard-cut shots detected in 34.5 s (at 5.0 and 22.7 s), but dissolves at about 0:12, 0:18 and 0:24 make about 8 scenes. No speed changes seen. Subtitles change every 2 to 5 s, near full sentences. Ends on the back cover.
q5_edit.why: Slow dissolves keep a gentle pace (E2), but they blur the children's reaction into the next clip (E2). Voice and subtitles stay in step (E4). The long top-down flip-through repeats itself (R1). It ends on the closing line, no tail (E8).

q6_topic.what: An aunt shows a personalised book she ordered for her nieces, and their reaction. It serves relatives looking for a gift that feels personal.
q6_topic.why: A relative as the buyer is a clear buying moment (K7), and a gift idea is easy to send on to another aunt (R5). The feeling is warm, "והכי מרגש", but not a peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: A static top-down phone shot on a lace tablecloth, hands opening the box and flipping pages; a side view of the thick pages; a static high-angle shot of four children on a tile floor; a man on a sofa with two girls.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands put the viewer in the reader's seat (F5), and the book fills the frame (F4). Bright home light looks native (F7). The children's faces carry the feeling (K8).

q8_text.on_screen: White text with a dark outline, 1 to 2 lines, centred about 78 to 83% down, near-full sentences changing every 2 to 4 s: "תראו איזה ספר מיוחד הזמנתי מ TinyBook" (0:00), "ב- Ai עם דמויות שבוחרים בעצמכם" (0:06), "אני בחרתי להכין אותו לאחייניות שלי" (0:09), "הספר עצמו מושקע ברמה אחרת" (0:14), "בכל מעבר דף נפתחת תמונה גדולה" (0:21), "איזה רגע קסום ב TinyBook" (0:32). No headline card, no CTA.
q8_text.caption: "הספר הכי מרגש שיצרתי לאחייניות שלי ב-AI." Two short lines, about 20 words, the second "סיפור אישי עם הדמויות שלנו, שהפך למזכרת משפחתית". No brand name, no hashtags, no ask. The paid-partnership label is set (15 Oct data).
q8_text.why: Burned-in sentences carry the whole voice, so it works muted (T1), but they sit in the bottom 35% over a busy picture (T2, T4, F2). The caption is short and names no brand or occasion (T7). The partnership is shown only by the label, with no Hebrew disclosure word (T8).

weak_points: No ask, price or code anywhere; "AI" in the subtitle and caption; four children's faces beside a book with their names; dissolves over the reaction; brand adjectives, not a first-hand detail.
lumebook_takeaway: Film the unboxing top-down on a cloth, add a side view of the page thickness, then one real reaction clip; add the offer, which this Reel lacks.
not_verified: The exact price and page count; whether the children are her nieces (said in the voice); whether music plays; whether the illustrations resemble the real family. The children's names are on the cover and the dedication, not quoted. Corrections to coded file: four children, not three, read the book at 0:20; the paid-partnership label comes from the 15 Oct data, not from the frames.
